name: jd.decode
description: Decode what the hiring manager actually wants from a JD: the real seat shape, the hidden must-have, and where a strategy-led candidate would be filtered. Feeds tailoring and the prep room.

real_seat.instructions: What the team will actually have this person do most days, reading past the title

criteria.hands_on_builder: Writes production code or models most days
criteria.player_coach: Builds some, leads a small team
criteria.strategist_operator: Sets direction, runs adoption, owns outcomes, does not code daily
criteria.customer_embedded: Sits with customers deploying and adopting the product
criteria.unclear: The JD does not make it clear

hands_on_required.instructions: The JD requires daily hands-on coding or model building as a must-have rather than a nice-to-have

hidden_filter.instructions: The most likely reason a strong strategy-and-adoption leader would be filtered out

criteria.years_of_eng_management: Requires many years managing software engineers
criteria.specific_platform: Requires deep experience in one named platform or vendor
criteria.industry_only: Requires years in one industry the candidate lacks
criteria.ic_depth: Requires IC-level depth in ML or infrastructure

outcome_owner.instructions: The role owns a business outcome (adoption, revenue, cost, customer result) rather than only technical delivery

reports_to_exec.instructions: The role reports to a C-level or SVP, or is described as leading AI for a business unit or the company

rules.reason: daily hands-on required; use the FDE master and lead with proof-studio
eng-management years filter; likely not worth a cold apply

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
